modes.name: Free Spins
modes.retrigger:
Retrigger can happen only once per reel and after the first
 retrigger on a reel, GOLDEN MONEY symbols can not appear anymore there.
modes.effects:
FEATURE
 Hit WILD symbols on reels 1 and 2 and BONUS on reel 3 to trigger the FREE SPINS feature.
 The round starts with 10 free spins.

 The MONEY COLLECT feature is active during free spins. During the round more and
 more are present on the reel strips.
 This is the GOLDEN MONEY symbol. It appears on reels 3, 4, and 5 only during the FREE SPINS round.
 Whenever the GOLDEN MONEY symbol hits, the number of possible symbols on that reel increases
 by 1 for the whole duration of FREE SPINS round, up to a maximum of 8 symbols per reel.
 Whenever a GOLDEN MONEY symbol hits on a reel that has already 8 symbols on it, a random number
 of 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 or 10 free spins is awarded. Retrigger can happen only once per reel and after the first
 retrigger on a reel, GOLDEN MONEY symbols can not appear anymore there.
 Special reels are in play during the feature.

features.effects:

ante bet activated, the chance for two WILD symbols to hit on reels 1 and 2 increases, thus increasing also
  the chance for COLLECT and FREE SPINS features to hit
